text.p: Bolder Technologies Corp said on Friday that it received a $750,000 grant from the federal government for the research and development of a new 5 Ampere-hour, 2-volt cell over a two-year period.
Bolder Technologies develops and manufactures advanced, high power rechargeable batteries based on its patented Thin Metal Film technology.
Bolder expects the new 5 Ah cell to have the highest power density of any other commercially available 5 Ah cell.

"We anticipate that the R&D project funded by this grant could also lead to additional enhancements to our overall manufacturing processes, which in turn will enable us to continue meeting or exceeding our customers' needs and expectations," Daniel Lankford, chairman and chief executive said in a statement,
